1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR INTERCOM SYSTEM (EPABX) MACHINES BY CONSIGNEE 1. Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) will be carried out at HQ CE (Navy) Visakhapatnam for the year 2026-27. 2. Maintenance of Intercom system (MITEL EPABX) for both the software and the hardware wi ll be for a period of 12 months with the following conditions: 2.1. Telecom lines Card will be replacement on AMC period if repair. 2.2. SMPS will be repair and replacement. 2.3. All floors of HQ CE(Navy) Visakhapatnam internal lines maintenance. 2.4. Software and Hardware checking and connecting. 2.5. DP Box and junction connector checking. 2.6. Joints and Digital cords connecting and checking 2.7. Room to room cable checking and connecting. 2.8. Condition of Phones dialing and checking. 2.9. Low and high voice checking. 3. Technical Specifications :- 3.1 Technology/ Architecture EPABX System : Hybrid 3.2 Number of Phones/ End Points : 64 lines 3.3 Number of Digital Phones card : 4 or supports 3.4 Number of Junction/ FXO ports (Max) : 4 Lines 3.5 Number of SIP Trunks (Max) : 8 lines or supports 3.6 Vintage of EPABX : 7 – 9 years 3.7 Frequency of Preventive Maintenance : Monthly 2 times 3.8 Need Local Technician 4. Additional cable as per requirement should be provided by bidder. 5. All equipments should be checked twice in a week. 6. The payment will be released on quarterly basis as per GeM provision. 7. Complaints should be attended within 4 hrs and the same should be rectified within 24 hrs. It not rectified within 24 hrs, failing which suitable penalty will be levied by the consignee as deemed fit. 8. No additional payment shall be admissible for replacement of any component, whether mi nor or major. 9. On expiry/ termination of the contract, the vendor shall handover all equipment under the c ontract in good working condition, before release of final bill. 10. The bidder shall satisfy himself regarding the existing condition of EPABX system before qu

oting rates. No claim on the ground that the system was old, defective, or required replacement of costly components shall be entertained after award of the contract. A certificate of site inspe ction done by the bidder inspecting the EPABX system at this office should be signed by the Ad m Officer or representative of Chief Engineer’s office and the same shall be uploaded with the bid by the bidder. Bids submitted without the Inspection Certificate are liable to be rej ected in Technical Bid Evaluation. 11. Bidder should mandatorily have an office in the Visakhapatnam. Office Registration Details including Address,TAN, GST numbers shall be provided along with the bid. Bidders are liable to be rejected on failing this criteria. 12. Common IP Address. Bidders may please note that GeM is capturing and showing the IP address used by the sellers. The receiving bids having Matching/ Common IP addresses shall be outrightly rejected and shall not be considered for further evaluation. 13. Security Deposit-Cum-Performance Gaurantee. Successful tenderers will have to de posit as security for satsifactory execution of orders and for guaranteed performance of the sup plied item for an amount equivalent to 3% of the ordered value in the form of Bank Guarantee within 21 days from the date of issuance of Work Order, from any Nationalized Bank. BG should have validity of 13 (Thirteen) months covering the entire AMC period. The security deposit will be refunded to the bidder without interest on completion/ warranty. .
